title: InstructDiff: Domain-Adaptive Data Selection via Contrastive Entropy for Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
authors_zh: Junyou Su, He Zhu, Xiao Luo, Liyu Zhang, Hong-Yu Zhou, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen
paper_type_zh: 领域自适应的监督微调数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 从混合指令或推理池选择模型特异监督微调子集的读者。
one_line: InstructDiff selects SFT records through calibration-induced NLL and entropy changes, retaining the lowest contrastive-entropy examples.
InstructDiff 以校准前后的负对数似然和熵变化选择监督微调记录，保留对比熵最低的例子。
why: It connects each candidate response to a measurable model-state change before it is admitted to SFT.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly determines which instruction-response records enter SFT by optimizing a model-relative selection criterion.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Supervised fine-tuning is increasingly performed on large instruction pools, yet training on every record can be expensive and can yield diminishing or negative returns. Existing selection rules are often tuned to one setting: heuristics that identify good conversational instructions need not identify useful mathematical reasoning traces, while difficulty or correctness filters designed for reasoning need not transfer to general instruction following.

The paper asks whether a single model-relative measurement can decide which instruction-response records should enter a limited SFT budget across domains. Its object is not generation at inference time: it changes the subset consumed by training. The intended decision is to retain records whose change in uncertainty between a base model and a lightly calibrated model signals useful learning, while rejecting records that are too redundant or too anomalous.

监督微调越来越常在大规模指令池上进行，但让每条记录都参加训练既昂贵，也可能带来递减甚至负面的收益。已有选择规则往往只适用于一种场景：能找出优质对话指令的启发式方法未必能找出有用的数学推理轨迹，而为推理设计的难度或正确性过滤也未必能迁移到通用指令遵循。

论文追问能否用一种与模型相关的统一度量，在多个领域中决定哪些指令—回答记录应进入有限的监督微调预算。它处理的不是推理时生成：它改变训练所消费的子集。目标决策是保留那些在基础模型与轻度校准模型之间不确定性变化显示出有用学习价值的记录，同时剔除过度冗余或过于异常的记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
InstructDiff compares two states of the same model family: the untouched base model and a copy lightly fine-tuned on a random warmup subset. For every candidate record, it measures the difference in response negative log likelihood and the difference in token-distribution entropy. The first quantity brackets a middle range of examples that are neither nearly redundant nor pathological; the second ranks the surviving examples.

The notable empirical claim is that the lowest contrastive-entropy records work best in every tested domain, even though the sign has different interpretations. Reasoning examples tend to show an entropy increase after calibration, described as cognitive expansion, whereas general instruction examples tend to show uncertainty compression. Thus the method does not hard-code a separate reasoning rule: it uses the relative state change to decide what data the next SFT run will see.

InstructDiff 比较同一模型家族的两个状态：未经改动的基础模型，以及在随机预热子集上轻度微调的副本。对每条候选记录，它度量回答负对数似然的差异和词元分布熵的差异。前一个量界定出既非近乎冗余、也非病态的中间例子范围；后一个量对保留下来的例子排序。

其显著的经验主张是，在所有测试领域中，最低对比熵的记录效果最好，尽管符号具有不同解释。推理例子在校准后往往表现为熵增加，被称为认知扩展；通用指令例子往往表现为不确定性压缩。因此该方法并未硬编码一条单独的推理规则，而是利用相对状态变化来决定下一次监督微调会看到哪些数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The procedure begins by randomly drawing roughly 10% of an instruction pool and fine-tuning it to form a calibration model. For each candidate, the authors compute length-normalized NLL and entropy under the base and calibration models. They discard the lowest and highest 10% of NLL differences, treating the former as low-signal near duplicates and the latter as potentially incomprehensible patterns, then select the lowest contrastive-entropy 10% of the original pool; code experiments use 20% for code.

The paper can repeat this loop after SFT, using the improved model as the next calibration state. It evaluates 10K-record pools of NuminaMath, Alpaca, MedCAQA, and BigCode with Qwen2.5-7B for mathematics and Llama3-8B elsewhere, and also tests 100K mathematics and 52K general pools. Comparisons include random, perplexity, absolute entropy, length, IFD, SelectIT, ZIP, Superfiltering, and full-data SFT. The paper explicitly links an official implementation repository.

流程先从指令池中随机抽取约 10%，在其上微调得到校准模型。对每个候选，作者在基础模型和校准模型下计算长度归一化的负对数似然与熵。他们丢弃负对数似然差异最低和最高的各 10%，分别将其视为低信号近重复和可能难以理解的模式，然后从原始池中选择对比熵最低的 10%；代码实验对代码数据选择 20%。

论文可在监督微调后重复这一循环，将提升后的模型作为下一轮校准状态。它在 NuminaMath、Alpaca、MedCAQA 和 BigCode 的 10K 记录池上评测，对数学使用 Qwen2.5-7B，对其他领域使用 Llama3-8B，并额外测试 100K 数学池和 52K 通用池。比较对象包括随机、困惑度、绝对熵、长度、IFD、SelectIT、ZIP、Superfiltering 与全量数据监督微调。论文明确链接了官方实现仓库。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With 10% selection, the reported mathematics average for Qwen2.5-7B is 31.63, compared with 27.05 for full 10K-data SFT; the AIME 2024 score is 7.71 versus 5.00. In the general setting, the selected subset has a 12.09% average over AlpacaEval and Arena-Hard compared with 8.15% for full-data training. The reported medical average is 56.42 versus 53.14, and code at a 20% budget is 45.1 versus 43.0.

Ablations support both parts of the selection rule: removing bidirectional NLL filtering lowers the mathematics, general, and medical figures, and selecting the lowest entropy-difference bin outperforms the middle and highest bins. On a 100K mathematics pool, selecting 10K reaches 29.80 against 27.16 for full training and 27.94 for random selection. The work also reports sensitivity: a 1% warmup is weaker, same-family calibration produces more overlap and better downstream selection than cross-family calibration, and two iterations give the strongest cost-performance trade-off before gains diminish.

在选择 10% 数据时，论文报告 Qwen2.5-7B 的数学平均分为 31.63，而完整 10K 数据监督微调为 27.05；AIME 2024 分数为 7.71 对 5.00。在通用设置中，所选子集在 AlpacaEval 与 Arena-Hard 上的平均为 12.09%，而全数据训练为 8.15%。报告的医学平均为 56.42 对 53.14，代码数据在 20% 预算下为 45.1 对 43.0。

消融支持选择规则的两个部分：去掉双向负对数似然过滤会降低数学、通用和医学结果，而选择熵差最低的分桶优于中间和最高分桶。在 100K 数学池上，选择 10K 达到 29.80，而全量训练和随机选择分别为 27.16 与 27.94。工作还报告了敏感性：1% 预热较弱，同家族校准比跨家族校准有更多重合且下游选择更好，两轮迭代在收益递减前给出最佳成本—性能权衡。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Many earlier selection methods evaluate one model state, use a static quality scorer, or specialize to either generic instruction data or verifiable reasoning data. This paper makes the selected record depend on a before-versus-after calibration comparison. It therefore treats the distributional response of a particular base model as part of the selection signal rather than asking a separate judge to assign a universal record quality.

Its contribution is not entropy regularization during optimization. Entropy is an offline measurement used to decide which response records are admitted to SFT, coupled to a symmetric learnability filter. The domain-adaptive aspect is also specific: the ranking direction stays fixed at lowest contrastive entropy, while the observed direction of uncertainty change differs between reasoning and general data. This separation of a common ordering from different underlying regimes is the paper's central design claim.

许多早期选择方法只评估一个模型状态、使用静态质量评分器，或只专用于通用指令数据与可验证推理数据之一。本文让被选择的记录取决于校准前后的比较。因此它把某一基础模型的分布响应作为选择信号的一部分，而不是要求独立裁判给出普适的记录质量。

其贡献不是在优化期间进行熵正则化。熵是一个离线度量，用于决定哪些回答记录被准入监督微调，并与对称的可学习性过滤相结合。领域自适应也有特定含义：排序方向始终是最低对比熵，而推理与通用数据中观察到的不确定性变化方向不同。把共同排序与不同底层机制分开，正是论文的核心设计主张。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Selection quality depends on a sufficiently good warmup calibration; the paper shows that a 1% warmup produces noisy distribution gaps and recommends about 1,000 warmup examples. The selected subsets are model-family specific: same-family models overlap far more than cross-family models, so reuse of a subset for another family is not assured. The reject and selection ratios are fixed at 0.1 in the main experiments, and automatic ratio choice remains open. Finally, the causal reason that entropy expansion appears useful for reasoning while compression appears useful for general tasks is not established, so the reported criterion should be revalidated when data, models, or task formats change.
选择质量依赖足够好的预热校准；论文显示 1% 预热会产生带噪声的分布差距，并建议约 1,000 个预热例子。所选子集具有模型家族特异性：同家族模型的重合远高于跨家族模型，因此不能保证一个子集可供另一家族复用。主实验把剔除比例和选择比例固定为 0.1，自动选择比例仍是开放问题。最后，为什么熵扩展对推理有益而压缩对通用任务有益的因果原因尚未建立，所以在数据、模型或任务格式变化时应重新验证该准则。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use InstructDiff when the practical decision is which subset of a heterogeneous SFT pool a particular target model should consume under a fixed budget. Preserve the base checkpoint, exact warmup draw and seed, calibration hyperparameters, tokenization, NLL and entropy definitions, both percentile cutoffs, candidate identifiers, and selection iteration. Re-run the measurement with a target or same-family model rather than assuming a subset transfers, and compare against random and full-data SFT under equal compute. Its official code is helpful for reproducing the criterion, but the paper's four source datasets retain their own licenses and provenance obligations.

当实际决策是在固定预算下让某个目标模型消费异质监督微调池中的哪个子集时，可使用 InstructDiff。应保留基础检查点、精确的预热抽样与随机种子、校准超参数、分词方式、负对数似然与熵定义、两个百分位截断、候选标识和选择迭代次数。应使用目标模型或同家族模型重新测量，而不是假定子集能迁移，并在相同计算预算下同随机与全数据监督微调比较。官方代码有助于复现该准则，但论文的四个来源数据集仍分别具有自己的许可和来源审查义务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The easiest way to read this work is to keep its two scores separate. NLL difference is a gate for records at a plausible learning frontier; contrastive entropy is the ordering inside that gate. The headline result is therefore not that low-entropy text is always good—absolute entropy baselines are tested separately—but that the change in uncertainty caused by a small calibration step identifies a useful training subset. The cross-family analysis is operationally important: the chosen records describe a relationship between a data pool and a model state, not an intrinsic ranked dataset.
阅读这项工作最容易的方式是把两个分数分开。负对数似然差异是让记录进入合理学习前沿的门槛；对比熵是门槛内部的排序。因而标题结果并非低熵文本总是优质——论文另行测试了绝对熵基线——而是小幅校准步骤造成的不确定性变化能识别有用训练子集。跨家族分析在实践上尤其重要：所选记录描述的是数据池与模型状态之间的关系，而不是一份具有内在固定排名的数据集。
